user.title: Eilwacht
user.description:
Breaking news from tagesschau.de work right away. Afterwards, add news watches for your federal state via “Add news watch”.

Source: tagesschau.de, for private use only. Eilwacht is not affiliated with ARD.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Eilwacht is already set up. Add news watches there.

user.title: Add news watch
user.description: Announces new items from the chosen federal states – optionally only those mentioning certain keywords.

data_description.name: For example “Stuttgart”. Used in entity names.
data_description.regions: Regional news of these states. “Germany-wide” adds national news without a state.
data_description.keywords: Optional, comma-separated. A keyword finds words starting with it: “Stuttgart” also finds “Stuttgarter”, “Streik” also “Streiks”. “*streik” also finds words containing it (“Warnstreik”), “-Fußball” excludes. Empty: every item.
